abstract: The Office of the United States Trade Representative (USTR) sought public comments to assist in the preparation of its annual report to Congress on China's compliance with its obligations as a Member of the World Trade Organization (WTO). USTR is postponing the public hearing that was scheduled to take place on October 7, 2025.

agencies.name: Trade Representative, Office of United States
agencies.raw_name: OFFICE OF THE UNITED STATES TRADE REPRESENTATIVE

dates: The public hearing scheduled for October 7, 2025 is postponed.
title: Postponement of Public Hearing Concerning China's Compliance With WTO Commitments
